BDI.note: The strategy only plans an ethics charter, algorithm controls and regulatory adaptation; no draft rule or authority is stated.
No government AI system piloted or in service is stated.
About fifteen sector pilots in health and agriculture are planned by the strategy, none stated under way.

facts.fact: Burundi validated its National Artificial Intelligence Strategy 2025-2030 in Bujumbura on 22 April 2026, led by the Ministry of Finance, Budget and Digital Economy with UNDP support; We are Tech calls it the strategy adopted.

systems.owner: Ministry of Finance, Budget and Digital Economy

BDI.note: Data centre modernisation and sector hubs are planned only; no model, dataset or AI computing named.
A target to train over 1,000 public agents is a strategy aim, not a programme launched.
Data centre modernisation is planned; no data centre for hire stated.

facts.fact: The national AI strategy validated on 22 April 2026 provides for developing sovereign cloud solutions alongside data centre modernisation.

BDI.note: No nationally owned data centre for hire is stated.
